done_when: A live app joins Forge in one human-merged pull request and never gets prototype rules

findings.body: This adds the user-facing adoption flow for items 6 and 7, but the supplied commit evidence says the worker's last commit has no `Functional check:` paragraph. Add a paragraph to that commit describing what was exercised and observed for both items.
findings.title: Not done: functional check

why: Forge can't tell a live production app from a prototype: without a sign-off record it applies prototype rules, it has no route to adopt a repo with history, and its pull-request check blocks the team's own branches
